summary.name: Ideogram
summary.one_liner: Ideogram is a generative media platform offering creative apps, image and video models (including its Ideogram 4.0/4.5 models), and a single API for image and video generation.
use_cases: remove backgrounds or objects from images
add image generation to a product via API
connect image generation to AI agents
summary.what_it_does: Ideogram provides a visual workspace for creating, editing, and iterating on images, with purpose-built apps for steps like background and object removal and resizing for different formats. Its API exposes image and video models through one endpoint with shared authentication and billing, and switching models means changing a model string in the request. An MCP integration lets clients such as Claude and Cursor generate and edit images within agent workflows. The catalog combines Ideogram's own models with models from other research labs. The page states that Ideogram 4.0 weights are available for local use under the applicable license.
notable: One API endpoint for multiple image and video models, switched by changing a model string
MCP support for Claude, Cursor and other agent clients
Ideogram 4.0 open weights available for local use under license
Enterprise plan with SSO, unlimited seats and legal indemnification
caveats: Business and Enterprise plans are needed for collaborative workflows, private generation, custom models and production support
Ideogram 4.0 local use is subject to the applicable license
Per-request API pricing; specific rates are not stated on the page
